command:
set -euo pipefail
requested_head="$PC043_EXPECTED_REVISION"
feature_path="specs/043-private-connectivity-production"
for revision in "$requested_head" "$PC043_BASE_REVISION" "$PC043_CHECKOUT_REVISION"; do
  [[ "$revision" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]
  git cat-file -e "$revision^{commit}"
done
[ "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$PC043_CHECKOUT_REVISION" ]
git merge-base --is-ancestor "$requested_head" "$PC043_CHECKOUT_REVISION"
export PC043_SOURCE_MODE=pr-head
if git cat-file -e "$requested_head:$feature_path" 2>/dev/null; then
  [ "$(git cat-file -t "$requested_head:$feature_path")" = tree ]
else
  git merge-base --is-ancestor "$PC043_BASE_REVISION" "$PC043_CHECKOUT_REVISION"
  ancestor="$(git merge-base "$requested_head" "$PC043_BASE_REVISION")"
  touched="$(git log --full-history -1 --format=%H "$ancestor..$requested_head" -- "$feature_path")"
  if git cat-file -e "$ancestor:$feature_path" 2>/dev/null || [ -n "$touched" ]; then
    echo "::error::A head that changed or removed feature 043 requires its own complete source suites."
    exit 1
  fi
  export PC043_EXPECTED_REVISION="$PC043_CHECKOUT_REVISION"
  export PC043_SOURCE_MODE=merge-checkout
  echo "::notice::Unrelated head predates feature 043; testing the merge checkout does not qualify the PR head."
fi
for module in test_evidence.py test_evidence_pins.py test_source_roots.py; do
  [ "$(git cat-file -t "$PC043_EXPECTED_REVISION:$feature_path/tests/$module")" = blob ]
done
printf '043 source selection: mode=%s revision=%s requested_head=%s\n' \
  "$PC043_SOURCE_MODE" "$PC043_EXPECTED_REVISION" "$requested_head"
original_tree="$(pwd)"
feature_tree="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/private-connectivity-043-source"
git -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null worktree add --detach "$feature_tree" "$PC043_EXPECTED_REVISION"
cd "$feature_tree"
[ "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$PC043_EXPECTED_REVISION" ]
echo "043 tested source: $(git rev-parse HEAD)"
python3 -m pytest -q \
  specs/043-private-connectivity-production/tests/test_evidence.py \
  specs/043-private-connectivity-production/tests/test_evidence_pins.py \
  specs/043-private-connectivity-production/tests/test_source_roots.py \
  --junitxml="$RUNNER_TEMP/private-connectivity-043-source.xml"
[ "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$PC043_EXPECTED_REVISION" ]
python3 - <<'PY'
from collections import Counter
import os
from pathlib import Path
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

expected = {
    "specs.043-private-connectivity-production.tests.test_evidence": 557,
    "specs.043-private-connectivity-production.tests.test_evidence_pins": 40,
    "specs.043-private-connectivity-production.tests.test_source_roots": 97,
}
report = ET.parse(Path(os.environ["RUNNER_TEMP"]) / "private-connectivity-043-source.xml").getroot()
cases = list(report.iter("testcase"))
actual = Counter(case.get("classname") for case in cases)
if dict(actual) != expected:
    raise SystemExit(f"043 source suite collection mismatch: {dict(actual)!r}; expected {expected!r}")
identities = [(case.get("classname"), case.get("name")) for case in cases]
if len(identities) != len(set(identities)):
    raise SystemExit("043 source report contains duplicate test identities")
for suite in report.iter("testsuite"):
    if any(int(suite.get(field, 0)) != 0 for field in ("failures", "errors", "skipped")):
        raise SystemExit("043 source suites must pass without failures, errors or skips")
if any(child.tag in ("failure", "error", "skipped") for case in cases for child in case):
    raise SystemExit("043 source testcase did not run and pass")
for name, count in sorted(actual.items()):
    print(f"043 source suite {name}: collected={count} passed={count} skipped=0 failures=0 errors=0")
PY
[ -z "$(git status --porcelain)" ]
cd "$original_tree"
git worktree remove "$feature_tree"
